status: experimental; interpolated frames require visual review
method: Capture 16 poses with a consistent head anchor. Estimate shirt boundaries per view, including a row-width hem detector in side view; normalize shirt height and projected hip-to-foot height in image space. Normal and low views share a projected reference, while the high view retains foreshortening. RIFE v4.6 interpolates RGB and alpha separately across each pair and the loop boundary; combine 32 frames in an 8x4 atlas. These operations cannot guarantee anatomical proportions and may distort poses. Front view uses the original registered artwork; its arm swing remains too small. An earlier cross-view arm composite was rejected due to detached sleeves and ghost edges.
tool: RIFE ncnn Vulkan, 20221029 Windows release, MIT, https://github.com/nihui/rife-ncnn-vulkan/releases/tag/20221029
reproduce: Build model, capture the 16 source frames using node tools/capture-candidate-sprite-frames.mjs for each direction/elevation, then run node tools/interpolate-candidate-sprites.mjs with ffmpeg and RIFE_NCNN_HOME installed.
